featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently used the courier services of Mr. Vishnu from VC International for a shipment from Mumbai to London. While the rates were initially attractive, the entire experience was extremely disappointing, despite his claim of having 8 years of experience in the industry. There were several red flags indicating why one should avoid using this service.

First and foremost, there was no tracking system for the shipment. Mr. Vishnu had assured me that the package would be delivered within 5 to 6 days, but it ultimately took 12 days to arrive. Even worse, instead of delivering it to the address provided, the package was left at ground level, not at the specified house number.

When I finally received the package, I was shocked to find that many containers were broken, indicating rough handling—something you wouldn't expect from a professional courier service. The boxes, which had been securely sealed at my house, appeared to have been opened and tampered with. New toys and clothes were missing, suggesting that items were stolen. Additionally, food grains were spilled throughout the box as they had been removed from their protective containers.

When I confronted Mr. Vishnu about these issues, he had no clear answers and avoided taking responsibility. It was evident that he had no control or knowledge of what was happening with the shipment at any stage—from the lack of tracking to the mishandling and possible theft of items.

Unfortunately, I had relied on Google ratings before choosing this service. However, I later noticed that all of the 5-star reviews seemed to come from a specific community and were likely posted by his friends and relatives, giving a misleading impression of the service quality.

I strongly advise against using his services. If, for any reason, you do choose to use them, I recommend withholding payment until you receive your parcel at the correct address and verify that all items are intact and accounted for. This has been one of the worst and most unprofessional experiences I've ever had with a courier service.
